findings.observation: Low contrast blue-grey stone keeps Marty silhouette and feet readable. Orthogonal paving agrees with wall perspective; repeated tile rhythm remains visible but subdued.
findings.production_followup: Break repeated paving motifs with restrained authored variants before large-area use.

findings.observation: Top lip and darker face clearly separate wall from floor; masonry size visually coherent with Marty and stone floor. No transparent gaps seen along repeated strip.
findings.production_followup: Repeated block pattern and moss line need variation for long spans; this 68-high wall is not the 44-high Farol face.

findings.observation: Muted timber belongs to palette but repeated horizontal bright/dark bands and same knots dominate the large patch.
findings.production_followup: Author two or three compatible plank arrangements and stagger joints; preserve pixel density and direction. Capture Marty over wood before accepting actor contrast there.
